Recursos opcionais do próprio Windows, l: Windows' own optional features, turned on and off by DISM (the exact command is shown first). The state is read now (Win32_OptionalFeature). Hyper-V, Virtual Machine Platform and Sandbox turn on the Windows hypervisor: this may reduce gaming performance a little and some anti-cheats don't work with it. On the Home edition, Hyper-V and Sandbox don't exist and show as unavailable. Each change can be undone here or in the Restore tab.
Ative ou desative recursos opcionais. Al: Turn optional features on or off. Some changes need a restart.
Reinicie o PC para concluir as mudanças: Restart the PC to finish the Windows feature changes.
Necessário para jogos e programas antigo: Required for older games and programs that ask for .NET 3.5.
Com o Hyper-V ativo o Windows roda sobre: With Hyper-V on, Windows runs on top of a hypervisor: it may reduce gaming performance a little and some anti-cheats don't work. Turn it on only if you need virtual machines.
Base usada pelo WSL 2 e pelo Android/out: Base used by WSL 2 and by Android/other virtualized apps.
Ativa o hipervisor do Windows: pode redu: Turns on the Windows hypervisor: it may reduce gaming performance a little and conflict with some anti-cheats.
Ambiente descartável para testar program: Disposable environment to test programs safely (Windows Pro/Enterprise).
Usa o hipervisor do Windows: pode reduzi: Uses the Windows hypervisor: it may reduce gaming performance a little and conflict with some anti-cheats.
Recurso de IA que guarda capturas da tel: AI feature that saves screen snapshots (Windows 11 24H2 on Copilot+ PCs).
Veja também o ajuste \"Bloquear capturas: See also the "Block Recall snapshots" tweak.
Player antigo do Windows (o novo Media P: Old Windows player (the new Media Player is not affected).
Ferramenta de linha de comando para test: Command-line tool to test network connections.
